questions.learningObjective: Identify the correct denominator for population density
questions.stem: A mapper reports 400 people per square kilometer for a city that includes lakes and parks; which denominator issue explains the inflated figure?

questions.subject: HUMAN_GEOGRAPHY
questions.topic: What the crude death rate measures
questions.stem: Explain what the crude death rate measures and why it is called crude.

answer.exemplar: The crude death rate counts deaths per 1000 people in the total population each year. It is called crude because it uses the whole population as denominator and ignores differences in age structure.

questions.explanation: The crude death rate divides annual deaths by total population. The label crude signals that age structure is ignored.
